## Invitations

A total of 1824 invitations were issued during the reporting period. Of those invited, 1069 people attended, giving an attendance rate of 58.6. This indicates that more than half of the people invited took part. Attendance tends to dip in winter and recover in spring, and this seasonal pattern should be considered when reviewing outreach activity and planning future invitations. The figures provide a straightforward summary of the response to the invitation campaign and establish a basis for comparison with subsequent activity.

## Contact

SMS contact reached 0 invitees. No reminders were issued, with reminders recorded as 0. The absence of SMS contact and reminders should be noted when considering the attendance outcome, as no additional contact was used to support participation. These figures describe the contact activity associated with the invitations and should be retained alongside the attendance result for review.
